abstract: Monitors abyssal water column turbidity and optical communications links
system_message:
You are Physical oceanography and optics lead (OPTC). You serve as the Physical oceanography and optics lead (OPTC). Your responsibilities include monitoring abyssal water column turbidity and optical communications links, as well as tracking deep-water conductivity and salinity across candidate abyssal observation sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Deep-water conductivity and salinity tracking（SAL）
information_points.content:
OPTC-SAL-Y7Y：At Fracture Zone Basin Sill, CTD profiling in the benthic boundary layer within 5 m of the seabed recorded a Benthic boundary layer practical salinity of 34.75 PSU.
OPTC-SAL-WX2：At Abyssal Plain Depocenter Node, deep-water CTD measurements within 5 m of the seafloor show a Benthic boundary layer practical salinity of 34.68 PSU.
OPTC-SAL-KBC：At Pelagic Ridge Flank Station, conductivity-temperature-depth casts taken within 5 m of the seabed establish a Benthic boundary layer practical salinity of 34.72 PSU.

information_points.title: Monitors abyssal water column turbidity and optical communications links（TURB）
information_points.content:
OPTC-TURB-5PT：For Fracture Zone Basin Sill under Modem firmware release Firmware release 3.2, laser burst telemetry evaluations over a 30 m link to the inspection AUV recorded an Optical burst modem uplink rate of 240 kbps.
OPTC-TURB-2AA：For Pelagic Ridge Flank Station under Modem firmware release Firmware release 4.0, optical modem sea trial measurements across the 30 m burst link demonstrate an Optical burst modem uplink rate of 240 kbps.
OPTC-TURB-5P8：For Pelagic Ridge Flank Station under Modem firmware release Firmware release 3.2, sea trial logs for the 30 m blue-green laser burst link to an inspection AUV document an Optical burst modem uplink rate of 120 kbps.
OPTC-TURB-635：For Abyssal Plain Depocenter Node under Modem firmware release Firmware release 3.2, effective error-corrected transmission trials across a 30 m range indicate an Optical burst modem uplink rate of 120 kbps.
